More than clean homes — we create moments of joy.

Joy Cleaning was born from a simple belief: a clean home is a happy home. Founded by Joyce Marsh & Aurea Smith , our team brings dedication, care, and a personal touch to every home we serve across the Atlanta area.

For over 9 years, we've been helping families reclaim their time and peace of mind — treating every space as if it were our own. No shortcuts, no rush, just real results you can feel.

Why Choose Us

The Joy Cleaning difference

We don't just clean — we care. Here's what sets us apart from every other service out there.

Background-Checked Team

Every cleaner on our team is carefully vetted, background-checked, and trained — so you can open your door with confidence.

We Bring Everything

All equipment, products, and supplies are included — you don't need to have a single thing at home. Just open the door and let us handle the rest.

100% Satisfaction Guaranteed

Not happy with something? We come back and make it right — no questions asked, no extra charge. Your satisfaction is our priority.

Flexible Scheduling

Weekly, biweekly, monthly or one-time — we fit around your life, not the other way around. Easy rescheduling when life gets busy.

9+ Years of Experience

Over nine years serving Atlanta families and businesses. We've seen it all and cleaned it all — you're in experienced hands.

Fully Insured & Bonded

We carry full liability insurance and are bonded — giving you total peace of mind every single time we come to your home.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Have a question? We probably have the answer. If not, don't hesitate to give us a call.

Our regular cleaning covers all living areas, bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, and common spaces. We dust surfaces, vacuum and mop floors, clean mirrors, wipe counters, scrub sinks and toilets, and take out trash. A detailed checklist is available on request.

Yes! We bring all the supplies and equipment we need. Our products are eco-friendly and safe for children and pets. If you have a preferred product or a specific area of concern, just let us know and we'll accommodate you.

Absolutely. Joy Cleaning LLC is fully insured and bonded. We carry general liability insurance for every job, so you can have complete peace of mind while our team is in your home.

Not at all! Many of our clients provide us with a key or door code so we can clean while they're at work or out. Our team is fully trusted and vetted. If you prefer to be home, that's perfectly fine too — we work around you.

Your satisfaction is guaranteed. If you're not completely satisfied, just let us know within 24 hours and we'll return to re-clean the areas at no additional cost. We're not done until you're happy.

You can book or reschedule easily by calling or texting us at (470) 854-8885, or by filling out the free estimate form on our website. We typically respond within an hour during business hours.

Yes! We offer discounted rates for clients who schedule recurring services — weekly, biweekly, or monthly. The more often you book, the better the rate. Contact us for a custom quote tailored to your frequency and home size.

We proudly serve Atlanta and the surrounding metro area, including Alpharetta, Marietta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Decatur, Johns Creek, Duluth, and more. Not sure if we cover your area? Give us a call and we'll let you know!
